question: What were Novo Nordisk's 2025 sales and operating profit, with growth in reported DKK vs constant exchange rates, and the USD equivalent of 2025 sales?
grading: DKK figures ±0.5% (DKK millions/billions, labeled); growth rates exact to 1pp for both reported and CER; USD conversion ±3% and must state the rate and its source; fail if DKK figures labeled as USD
answer: Novo Nordisk 2025 sales were DKK 309,064 million, up 6% reported / 10% at constant exchange rates. Operating profit was DKK 127,658 million, down 1% reported / up 6% at CER. Using the Federal Reserve 2025 annual-average rate of DKK 6.6137 per USD, sales translate to approximately USD 46.7309 billion. This is an analyst translation of DKK-reported IFRS sales. [G26-E1, G26-E2]

output.answer:
## Novo Nordisk FY2025 Results (announced 3 February 2026)

**Net sales:** DKK 309,064 million
- **+6%** growth as reported (DKK)
- **+10%** growth at constant exchange rates (CER)

**Operating profit:** DKK 127,658 million
- **–1%** growth as reported (DKK)
- **+6%** growth at CER

**USD equivalent (2025):**
- Net sales ≈ **$43.27 billion**
- Operating profit ≈ **$17.88 billion** (at CER)

### Key context
- Operating profit was dampened by ~DKK 8 billion in one-off restructuring costs tied to a company-wide transformation and by impacts from the three former Catalent manufacturing sites (partly offset by the prior-year ocedurenone impairment). **Excluding restructuring costs**, operating profit would have risen 6% as reported and 13% at CER.
- By segment: Diabetes & Obesity care sales +7% DKK (10% CER); Obesity care +26% DKK (31% CER); Rare disease +5% DKK (9% CER).
- Net profit +1% to DKK 102,434 million; diluted EPS +2% to DKK 23.03; free cash flow DKK 28.3 billion.

Sources:
- Novo Nordisk Annual Report 2025: https://annualreport.novonordisk.com/2025/strategic-aspirations/financial-performance.html
- Full-year company announcement: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b355e580b928a809510a7738f28c9c420&lang=en&src=micro
- PharmExec summary (USD figures): https://www.pharmexec.com/view/novo-nordisk-2025-financial-report-2026-sales-operations-profit-outlook

Note: The USD equivalents come from a secondary source; Novo Nordisk reports primarily in DKK, so exact USD conversions depend on the exchange rate used.
